players.product: Helios AI/HPC data-center campus (West Texas, 800 gross MW) leased to CoreWeave, plus Merlin / Caspian / Selene Texas development sites - ex-Bitcoin-mining site (Galaxy Power)

quarterly_data.signal: Christopher Ferraro: "The lights are on at the Helios campus. We've delivered the first data hall to CoreWeave" (called the most significant milestone since signing the lease; the site was a Bitcoin mining facility not long ago). "We remain on track to deliver substantially all of the 133 MW of critical IT capacity for Phase 1 by the end of Q2."
quarterly_data.figure: First data hall delivered; substantially all of 133 MW Phase 1 critical IT on track by end of Q2

quarterly_data.signal: CFO Anthony Paquette: data-center financial results remained de minimis in Q1 during final construction and commissioning of Phase 1; revenue begins ramping in Q2 as data halls are delivered under the CoreWeave lease - 15-year contracted cash flows at approximately 90% average lease level EBITDA margins, uncorrelated to digital asset prices. CEO Mike Novogratz: Galaxy will be less cyclical to crypto 'just because of data center earnings, you know, 12 months from now.'
quarterly_data.figure: 15-year contracted cash flows; approximately 90% average lease-level EBITDA margins; Q1 data-center results de minimis

quarterly_data.signal: Phase 2: meaningful progress on greenfield construction for the 260 MW of incremental critical IT capacity (site work, concrete and steel advancing on new buildings); Phase 2 data hall deliveries on track to commence in the first half of 2027. Strong demand for financing the build; more to share on Phase 2 financing in the near term. Management said the high yield bond market has taken share from bank syndicates and spreads have tightened across the board, and, asked by an analyst about a peer's restructuring with an ultimate parent guarantee from the IG-rated hyperscaler using the compute, said 'all options are on the table'.
quarterly_data.figure: 260 MW Phase 2 critical IT; deliveries to commence in the first half of 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Leasing the available 830 MW: demand for large-scale HPC capacity 'remains very strong'; in active discussions with a select group of potential customers for a lease of 'multiple years and $ billions of contracted revenues'; Novogratz expects it to be 'probably gonna be a second half of the year process'. Ferraro: customer conversations extend 'pretty far beyond just CoreWeave' and the decision will weigh a diversified (multi-tenant) client base. Headline rent with CoreWeave called 'a standout in the market'; after-financing economics on the next capacity expected to be equally attractive.
quarterly_data.figure: 830 MW approved front-of-the-meter ERCOT power unleased; no specific figure on lease value

quarterly_data.signal: Without waiting for a tenant, Galaxy has begun procuring critical infrastructure for the 830 MW development: 'we have placed deposits and issued purchase orders on main power transformers and circuit breakers for the first phase of that development and have secured capacity for the balance of long-lead electrical infrastructure. Lead times for this equipment stretch to multiple years.'

ERCOT draft rule PGRR145 (mid-March) creates a base load category for projects with a 2028 energization date that are not re-studied in Batch 0; Galaxy's interconnection studies were completed on January 15 and its service agreement is executed, so management says the 830 MW is eligible for base load within Batch 0. An additional 1.8 GW is progressing through the ERCOT study process and its timing is the open question; best visibility on the batch framework is around June.
quarterly_data.figure: 830 MW eligible for Batch 0 base load; additional 1.8 GW in ERCOT study process

quarterly_data.signal: Scaling beyond Helios is a priority: a deep pipeline of U.S. sites is being evaluated selectively; 'Several of those sites have progressed to LOIs, and we expect we will be discussing our multi-campus portfolio within this year.' Novogratz: new projects outside Helios are at LOI stage, separate from Helios.

Q1 firmwide results were driven mainly by unrealized mark-to-market losses on balance-sheet digital assets: GAAP net loss of $216 million, or a loss of $0.49 per share, and firmwide adjusted EBITDA of negative $188 million; ended Q1 with approximately $10 billion in total assets and total equity capital of $2.8 billion. Second quarter to date adjusted EBITDA estimated at approximately $90 million. Potential repayment of $445 million of exchangeable notes maturing in December.
quarterly_data.figure: GAAP net loss of $216 million; adjusted EBITDA of negative $188 million; Q2-to-date adjusted EBITDA approximately $90 million

connects_to.relationship: Helios campus (West Texas) AI data-center capacity

contracts.signal: First Helios data hall delivered to CoreWeave, with substantially all of the 133 MW Phase 1 critical IT on track by end of Q2 under the 15-year lease. Ferraro: 'CoreWeave, has indicated that it expects a $multi-trillion investment-grade public company to be the end user for their GPUs at our Phase 1 Helios facility once the clusters are operational.' CoreWeave then takes another 2-3 months to build out the inside for the final customer (Novogratz). CoreWeave is 'our biggest partner in the business today'.
